title: Transformer outperformed by RNN Grammar on constituency parsing
description: On English constituency parsing, the Transformer model yielded better results than all previously reported models except the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar, which still outperforms the Transformer on this task.
canonical_description: pure-attention model outperformed by RNN-based model on structured prediction task

evidence.anchor: with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar
evidence.quote: Our results in Table~[REF:tab:parsing-results] show that despite the lack of task-specific tuning our model performs surprisingly well, yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar [CITE:dyer-rnng:16].
